entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: When the matter is called out, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State are present.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that by filing supplementary affidavit he has brought on record the fact that after verifying all the documents police has found case to be only under sections 498A,504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and, therefore, the offecne under sections 376 and 307 IPC may no longer lie.
Learned counsel for the informant seeks and is granted time to file counter affidavit.
Learned counsel for the State is also directed to file counter affidavit by the next date of hearing.
